Composition2.description: What a customer assembled in library mode (BRIEF Section 16): the order record and the only input to a library export. Contract 2 (Section 17): Kiosk to fulfilment, and the seed of a bespoke job. Geometry is the family's mesh (decision 116) plus the family delta plus one part variant of that mesh per region, plus shell parts on sockets; colour is the base colour, then pattern layers in order (signed-distance masks thresholded at their coverage), then stamps, then eyes and nose.

breed_id.description: The breed the customer started from (informational).

layers.description: Pattern layers, composited in this order over the base colour.

coverage.description: The mask threshold: the layer covers texels whose mask value is below coverage.

parts.description: One region-delta part id per region; a region left out keeps the family's shape.

release_version.description: The library release the ids refer to.

stamps.description: Spots, patches and brush dabs, painted after the layers in this order. Positions are on the undeformed mesh (mm, the mesh the composition names), so a stamp stays put when parts change and lands correctly across UV seams. Symmetry writes the mirrored stamp explicitly.

Composition2.title: Composition

Composition3.description: The kiosk's order record for a breed with a part kit in the release (release 3.0): the breed's kit, a variant per kind, the torso's shape (preset), a pose and a texture. The only input to its print export. Variants a pose swaps in (sitting folds the hind legs) override the composition's for those kinds.

ReleaseManifest.description: manifest.json of a library release bundle, release-<species>-<n>.tar (BRIEF Section 17, contract 1: Studio to Kiosk). Release 2.0 (decision 118): every family and part variant names the mesh it is built on; meshes are unique per figurine and labelled to one segmentation schema. The tar holds manifest.json, manifest.sig (HMAC-SHA256 of manifest.json with the release key) and every file listed, each checked by sha256 on load. Drafts and rejected parts never appear here.

post.description: Add or change the email or phone, with a code sent to it; it must not belong to another account.
Register this device for push notifications (a Firebase Cloud Messaging token).
Link Apple or Google to this account; 409 when that sign-in or its email is another account's.
Sign in with Apple or Google (their id token). A verified email an account already holds joins that account.
Sign in with the code; the first sign-in to an email or phone creates its account.

Place the order: the ticket, and Stage F on the kiosk queue (idempotent). A guest gives a contact (email or
phone) for the "it is ready" message; a signed-in account (bearer token) may use its own.

post.description:
Start paying for an ordered composition (its export requested). A new call replaces a pending payment
(another method, or an expired QR); a paid order answers 409.
The fake provider only (tests, demos): mark the pending payment paid. 403 with a real provider.
